docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The eighty-five essays that argued for the ratification of the Constitution of the United States.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Alexander Hamilton (1757–1804), John Jay (1745–1829) and James Madison (1751–1836), The Federalist (1787–1788). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
